customManagers.description: v1/ansible compose templates (Jinja): literal image refs, digest-only refs, and Jinja default() pins, either as the tag or as the whole image reference

v2 plain-YAML app manifests, compose/swarm-compose files, and the 2 skfence Jinja compose templates: literal image refs (v2 has no Jinja default() image pins today; the one bash-style ${VERSION:-latest} reference in v2/apps/skfence is not extractable by this pattern and is called out in docs/dependency-updates.md)

packageRules.description: Group minor/patch/digest bumps per service directory; majors are never grouped so each lands as its own reviewable PR. Renovate does not template groupName (a literal {{parentDir}} put every bump into one branch, renovate/parentdir, PR #421), so the directory goes into the branch prefix and the PR title instead: one branch per package-file directory.
CI Python stays on 3.12: ansible-core in CI fails on Python 3.15 (AttributeError: module 'dataclasses' has no attribute '_is_type', PR #421). Raise this together with ansible-core.
dmacvicar/libvirt stays on 0.8.x: 0.9 rewrote the resource schema (libvirt_pool target block, libvirt_network mode are gone; tofu tests failed on #421). Moving to 0.9 is a module rewrite, not a bump.

skmon's Python runtime images (bridge, exporter) stay on 3.13: a Python minor is a runtime change for code we run, not a patch (#421 proposed 3.13 -> 3.15). Raise this cap by hand with a skmon test run; patch and digest bumps within 3.13 still flow.
docker-mailserver majors need a human: prod was three majors behind what :latest resolved to before this framework started pinning (see test_skmail_dms_version_pinned.py)
postgres majors need a human: in-place major upgrades need a pg_upgrade/dump-restore step, never an unattended image swap

skmem-pg and the skdata stub stay on Postgres 17: the sovereign image is built from our own Dockerfile (pgvector + ParadeDB pg_search + Apache AGE) and no Postgres 18 build is published. Re-enable when a pg18 image exists.
Authentik (sksso) majors need a human: config/schema migrations between majors are not always backward compatible
Forgejo (skgit) majors need a human: git hosting is not something to auto-upgrade unattended
Nextcloud (skhub) majors need a human: app-store compatibility and data migrations across majors are not safe to automate

ghcr.io/immich-app/postgres is pinned to exactly what the pinned Immich release's docker-compose.yml names (Immich supports only that image and tag, and the PG major must never change silently); it moves only with an IMMICH_VERSION bump
mariadb tracks the newest LTS that Nextcloud supports (12.3, patch builds only); rolling majors such as 13.x are not supported by Nextcloud and are short-lived

skstacks keeps its per-service grouping above (it overrides the shared weekly groups) and does not auto-merge ordinary updates: an image bump here changes running infrastructure, so every non-security PR gets a human or orchestrator review. Security fixes still merge themselves when every check is green (shared preset).
FalkorDB (skgraph) and Qdrant (skvector) are retired from the estates: skmemory moved to skmem-pg. Do not propose updates for their images or roles.
No updates at all for the retired skgraph and skvector roles.
skmon pins.yml requires every image to be at least 14 days old (test_skmon_pins.py); match it so skmon bumps do not fail CI
Nextcloud supports MariaDB up to 12.3 LTS; 13.x is a rolling release it does not support (migration plan 2026-11-20)
Fleet Postgres target is 18 (guarded roles); 19.0 is unvalidated. Revisit at 19.1+ (migration plan 2026-11-20)
skgallery: the dump sidecar must match Immich's Postgres server (14, upstream compose); hold both until Immich moves
skflow/skbom have no Postgres major guard or PG18 mount layout yet; stay on 17 until they do
MySQL: LTS 8.4 line only, no innovation releases
Promtail is deprecated; skmon moves to Alloy instead of promtail 3
